window.jobs: tier-1 failed jobs (testfailed/busted) with a staff label in {fixed by commit, intermittent, infra, autoclassified intermittent, intermittent needs bugid} by 2026-10-23
window.sample: every such job whose id ends in 0 or 1 (deterministic 20% sample), capped at 3,000 per week

price_change: announced at the freeze: from 2026-10-14 00:00 UTC, macOS runner minutes cost 5x and Windows 2x the published price; Linux and all other costs unchanged

policies.dp: C.pol_dp with the frozen model; re-solved for week-2 prices with no new data
policies.llm_controllers: Qwen3.8-27B (vLLM, no thinking) and Opus 5.5 (claude -p), prompts in ci_llm.py (control, informed); informed facts = ci_facts.json with week-2 prices for week-2 failures; run after the window with the frozen prompts

scoring: ci_triage.simulate with the frozen model: real same-push retrigger outcomes when observed, otherwise frozen odds; costs at the regime's prices; push-clustered bootstrap

predictions.P1: DP cost per failure in each week falls inside its forecast interval
predictions.P2: DP minus best rule < 0 in each week (95% interval below zero)
predictions.P3: DP minus each LLM controller < 0 in each week
predictions.P4: after the price change the DP's macOS retrigger share falls and its forecast still holds
